fusions.name: Two-Way Jab
fusions.desc: A forked jab that deals 4 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Branching Venom
fusions.desc: Spits a bolt that hits the first enemy in its path for 14 damage, leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and [Slowed] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Pulled to the Point
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 5 enemies within 8 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Tine
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
